patterns.note: A fluid, asymmetrical image grid dominates the page, displaying images of varying aspect ratios without strict alignment, creating a dynamic, collage-like visual flow.
Minimalist typography uses a clean sans-serif for all functional text, contrasting with a large, custom logotype for the primary brand identity.
The site employs a stark black and white base palette for structural elements and text, allowing the vibrant and diverse colors within the photography to provide all visual interest.

On scroll, the initial large, centered 'wsm' logo fades out and disappears, while a smaller, more compact 'wsm' logo simultaneously appears and sticks to the top-right corner, joining the persistent top-left utility navigation (hamburger menu and search icon).
The site eschews traditional content sections, presenting a continuous, uninterrupted scroll of imagery that functions as a single, expansive gallery.

technique_notes: The primary visual effect is a responsive, fluid image grid that dynamically arranges images of various sizes and aspect ratios, creating an editorial, art-gallery aesthetic without rigid column structures.

The header features a dynamic transformation on scroll: an initial large hero logo is replaced by a smaller, sticky version that integrates into the top navigation bar, maintaining brand presence while maximizing content space.

The overall design relies on extreme minimalism, using ample negative space and a monochromatic interface to ensure that the high-quality, full-bleed photography is the absolute focal point of the user experience.

design_tokens.type_scale: A custom, oversized logotype for the brand name, with all other functional text (navigation, footer) being consistently small and understated sans-serif.
design_tokens.spacing: airy — particularly in the initial hero area with the large logo; the image grid itself is dense with minimal gutters between images.

standout: This site's design is distinctive for its radical minimalism, which completely defers to the photography. The dynamic, non-uniform image grid, combined with the subtle header transformation, creates an immersive, art-gallery experience that feels curated and high-end, rather than a standard structured portfolio.
